name: Squall Weighttip
description: Raises the weight from the court stance in a straight rising stroke at the foe's face.

name: Stately Meteorhead
description: Salutes with the cord drawn across the chest and turns the first blow aside.

name: Vigor Tailstone
description: Advances in even court paces so that the weight arrives with the lead foot.

name: Bedrock Gyre
description: Opens the school's orbit with qi along the cord and lets it carry the first blow.

name: Thrallplumb
description: Wraps the foe's weapon arm in the cord at the end of the salute and draws it in.

name: Plumbtriumph
description: Sweeps the weight in a wide courtyard circle at knee height against all who stand near.

name: Pealcable
description: Reverses the orbit as an attack lands and strikes the attacker on the return.

name: Vacuumplumb
description: Drops the weight from overhead with qi gathered behind the iron to punch through a guard.

name: Catching Loopend
description: Spreads a net of tightening cord across the ground before the school's line to snare any who rush it.

name: Steelcable
description: Gathers a long overhead orbit of qi and drops the weight in one shattering fall.

name: Lordly Vigor Weightneck
description: The school's closing stroke gathers the whole orbit of the court into one fall that ends the bout.

name: Matchless Revolve
description: Raises the weight and the cord end together like two hawks lifting from one perch.

name: Vigor Ropehead
description: Steps to the angle from which the weight will fall and no foe expects it.

name: Pealwhorl
description: Flicks the cord end like a talon at the foe's eyes and sword hand.

name: Solid Orbitband
description: Holds the two cord strands crossed in front of the body to catch a blade between them.

name: Cabletriumph
description: Drops the weight from above on a diving line with a qi-fed snap of the cord.

name: Longrope Reliquary
description: Throws two strands in a crossing loop that snares the sword wrist and cinches tight.

name: Millstone Reelback
description: Hooks the foe's raised arm with the cord and pulls it down into the weight's path.

name: Undaunted Ropehead
description: Lets a cut pass under the stoop and counters with the weight on the foe's exposed back.

name: Steel Dropweight
description: Stoops weight and trailing strand along one line to pierce the guard with massed qi.

name: Thunderclap Longrope
description: Chases a retreating foe with diving steps and strikes with the weight as he turns.

name: Heroic Plummet
description: Brings weight and cord down together so the strike covers the foe's whole view.

name: Haemal Spinout
description: The school's final pair of strokes stoops with weight and cord from two heights as one descent.

name: Steelplumb
description: Drags the weight along a low shelf of ground and lifts it under the foe's knee.

name: Revered Cordsplice
description: Blocks a cut on the cord held at the exact angle the school teaches.

name: Dropweight Voyage
description: Plants the feet along the edge of the swing so the weight never crosses the body.

name: Noble Reelback
description: Swings the weight in a wide basin arc with qi that carries it through a guard.

name: Millstone Orbitband
description: Drags the cord through loose ground until it thickens and winds about the foe's legs.

name: Peal Meteorhead
description: Meets a blow and sends the weight back along the same line like an echo.

name: Inferno Slingshot
description: Pours gathered qi into the weight and drops it so that the ground around buckles.

name: Sigil Slingshot
description: Draws every cord-caught foe toward the center of the swing as water drains to a basin's low point.

name: Bedrock Spinout
description: Fills the ground with orbits until it brims and releases them in one great fall.

name: Vaunted Plummet Decree
description: The school's closing whirl turns the whole basin of the swing into one ring of falling iron.

name: Squall Weightneck
description: Opens with a sweeping swing of the weight that starts both tracks turning.

name: Bedrock Tailstone
description: Walks the sweep on two lines in turn so that the weight follows each foot.

name: Deluge Loopend
description: Sweeps the cord across an attack and carries it past the shoulder.

name: Unbending Orbitband
description: Sends one stroke low and the other high so the foe cannot guard both.

name: Triumphant Revolve
description: Passes the weight across the foe's front with qi enough to crush a raised shield.

name: Sigilplumb
description: Hooks a leg at the end of the low sweep and pulls it out from under the foe.

name: Bedrock Plummet
description: Reverses the weight off a parried blow and sweeps the other way into the open flank.

name: Fearless Ropehead
description: Keeps both tracks sweeping across a lane so that no foe can walk down it.

name: Sovereign Cordsplice
description: Surges both sweeps outward with rising qi until they strike every foe within the rope's reach.

name: Pulsar Slingshot
description: Drives the sweeping weight at one spot of a guard with qi massed until the guard breaks.

name: Storied Gyre
description: Links the two sweeps in one unbroken chain that no parry can find a gap in.

name: Noble Steel Weighttip
description: The school's finishing sweep brings both tracks around to one point with all the gathered qi.

name: Steelponderer
description: Casts the weight in a long bending line that dips like a hawk over a river.

name: Prismcable
description: Holds the cord in the guard figure the codex draws first before the body.

name: Deft Weighttip
description: Steps light across the shallows of the foe's reach and returns before the weight lands.

name: Gallant Meteorhead
description: Runs the orbit like a river in flood and strikes with the hawk's sudden stoop at its edge.

name: Millstone Spinout
description: Lets the cord drop over the foe like a hawk's shadow and draws it tight about the arms.

name: Deluge Dropweight
description: Wades through the line of a cut as through a ford and strikes the attacker on the far side.

name: Weightneck Covenant
description: Raises a current of whirling cord that spoils the footing and rhythm of every approach.

name: Reelback Crown
description: Dives the weight with a rising river's force behind it and pierces a guard.

name: Tempestuous Cordsplice
description: Throws the weight high so that it falls and rebounds in a rain across a wide stretch of ground.

name: Squall Revolve
description: Gathers the river's run and the hawk's height into one slow descent of the weight.

name: Peerless Haemal Gyre
description: The school's closing descent joins stream and stoop in a single fall that ends the exchange.

name: Cablecrown
description: Swings the weight in the plain foundation arc the whole school is built upon.

name: Deluge Longrope
description: Parries with the cord held high and open as the sky and sheds a blow to either side.

name: Squall Slingshot
description: Walks the plain foundation circle while the weight turns once about the body.

name: Plumbbanner
description: Drives the orbit with Core qi in a steady turn that strikes through any ordinary guard.

name: Cording Loopend
description: Wraps the cord about a limb with a pulse of Core qi that locks the turns in place.

name: Tailstone Covenant
description: Whirls the weight against an attack in a counter that sheds the blow and strikes back.

name: Pulsarponderer
description: Feeds Core qi into the falling weight so that it pierces plate and the body behind it.

name: Rakeplumb
description: Drives a tempest of orbits fed by Core qi that strikes every foe in the rope's range.

name: Exalted Gyre
description: Condenses Core qi into the iron through a long slow orbit and plummets it onto one foe.

name: Thunderclap Spinout
description: The school's complete descent draws every orbit of the teaching into a single fall of the weight.

name: Vigorcable
description: Casts the weight on the first sworn wind so that it runs the length of the rope.

name: Stolid Orbitband
description: Holds the cord taut as a sworn line before the body so blows must cross it.

name: Twilit Ropehead
description: Advances with the wind at the back so that the weight and the body gain speed together.

name: Venom Tailstone
description: Taps the weight against a raised weapon and holds the bearing while the foe is thrown off line.

name: Inferno Meteorhead
description: Opens the school's orbit with wind and qi so that the first pass carries a hard blow.

name: Sigilwhorl
description: Throws the sworn cord around the weapon arm and locks it as a vow is locked.

name: Magmaponderer
description: Sweeps the weight with a gale's push about the ankles of every foe nearby.

name: Delugewhorl
description: Turns with the wind against a charge and sends the weight into the attacker's flank.

name: Thunderclap Reelback
description: Drops the weight with the wind behind it and qi massed in the iron through the guard.

name: Cableseal
description: Lays a taut cord across open ground in the line of the gale to snare any who rush across.

name: Gyreedict
description: Gathers the sworn wind into the weight through a long swing and lets it fall as one blow.

name: Vigorwhorl
description: The school's closing oath is a single sworn cast that carries the weight to its mark on the wind.

name: Haemal Loopend
description: Swings the weight with feet set on the plateau and the oath spoken before the blow.

name: Pall Longrope
description: Parries along the cord with the arm angle the syllabus fixes for every kind of cut.

name: Vigor Weighttip
description: Steps along the plateau edge with the weight trailing to hold the foe back from it.

name: Lashing Dropweight
description: Hooks the cord on a limb and holds it fast as one holds to a sworn word.

name: Inferno Cordsplice
description: Runs an orbit with the plateau wind behind it that gathers speed with each turn.

name: Peal Orbitband
description: Meets a charge at the edge and turns the weight back to drive the foe over it.

name: Royal Weightneck
description: Pierces a guard with a stroke of the weight that carries qi and a sworn bearing.

name: Sigilgyre
description: Hauls a bound foe along the plateau with a steady pull the whole body drives.

name: Squall Reelback
description: Throws the weight high into the plateau sky and brings it down like a falling star.

name: Steel Plummet
description: The school's closing fall drops the weight on the bearing the oath has set.

name: Haemalponderer
description: Casts the weight along a bearing taken before the throw and holds it to the end.

name: Sound Weighttip
description: Turns the cord in the third course guard that closes every line the first two left open.

name: Squall Dropweight
description: Slides along the bearing to keep the same line while the foe moves off it.

name: Ropehead Banner
description: Cuts the orbit along the held bearing so a gust cannot throw it off.

name: Sigil Meteorhead
description: Locks the cord about a weapon along the held line and refuses the foe's pull.

name: Revolve Covenant
description: Breaks the foe's own bearing with a sharp tug of the cord at the lead ankle.

name: Tailstone Pledge
description: Turns the bearing a quarter to meet a cut and strikes the attacker as the line swings round.

name: Spinout Decree
description: Gathers qi along the held bearing and casts the hammer through the guard at the end of it.

name: Gyre Verdict
description: Throws cast after cast down one bearing until the foe can only crouch behind his guard.

name: Squall Plummet
description: Holds the bearing through a long pause then drops the whole weight onto the mark.

name: Haemal Revolve
description: The school's closing stroke lets the hammer fall on the bearing as taught in the third course.

name: Haemal Slingshot
description: Throws the weight with the gale behind it to the full length of the rope.

name: Sturdy Loopend
description: Braces the cord across the chest and sets the feet against the push of a heavy cut.

name: Squall Longrope
description: Strides long with the gale at the shoulder while the weight swings clear of the feet.

name: Vigor Cordsplice
description: Casts the orbit on the gale and crushes a raised guard with the weight's returning swing.

name: Sigil Revolve
description: Throws a gale-bent loop that closes about a limb and cinches on the pull.

name: Pealponderer
description: Turns with the gust against a cut and answers with the weight on the open side.

name: Triumphant Longrope
description: Holds a line of repeated casts across a path so that nothing crosses it unhurt.

name: Plumbcrown
description: Casts the iron on the gale with massed qi so that it pierces a guard.

name: Tempestuous Weighttip
description: Throws the iron high and lets it fall and bound across the ground in the gale's wake.

name: Royal Ropehead
description: Gathers qi in the iron and casts it on the gale in a long bright arc to its mark.

name: Vigor Reelback
description: The school's closing cast sends the iron on the gale to the very end of the rope.

name: Thunderclap Loopend
description: Casts the weight as the codex's first plate shows with the sworn wind along its line.

name: Prismponderer
description: Spins the weight in the guard ring the codex gives against thrusts from the front.

name: Whorlodyssey
description: Steps with each foot on the held bearing so that cord and body never part ways.

name: Eclipse Meteorhead
description: Probes the air about the foe with the weight and reads his guard from the cord's tremor.

name: Steel Orbitband
description: Smashes the orbit down with the sworn wind and a field of qi behind the iron.

name: Slingshot Vow
description: Binds the foe's arms in the cord as the codex shows and draws him off his footing.

name: Immaculate Tailstone
description: Whirls the weight against a cut and answers on the same line before the foe has recovered.

name: Gyretriumph
description: Draws a line of falling weights across the ground that pins any foe behind it.

name: Radiance Weightneck
description: Drives the weight along the sworn wind and punches through the guard with massed qi.

name: Magmagyre
description: Raises a storm of orbits from the codex's great plate that strikes every foe around.

name: Vigor Gyre
description: Gathers the sworn wind and a long field of qi into the weight and brings it down in one fall.

name: Majestic Inferno Weightneck
description: The school's closing vow is a single descent of the weight on the bearing sworn in the codex.

name: Unrivaled Weighttip
description: Opens with a swing that gathers the gale into the weight from the first beat.

name: Faithful Orbitband
description: Parries on the cord set in the angle that teachers pass on from the first lesson.

name: Loopend Odyssey
description: Steps round a full circle of bearings with the weight turning once at the hip.

name: Famed Slingshot
description: Drives the orbit with Core qi in a steady wind that crushes a guard in the second pass.

name: Ruling Spinout
description: Wraps the cord on a Core-driven gust round a limb and locks it in place.

name: Pallcable
description: Reverses the orbit as taught and strikes the attacker as his own blow runs out.

name: Prismwhorl
description: Throws the weight on the gale with Core qi behind the iron through a guard.

name: Reapwhorl
description: Raises the whole gale in a storm of orbits fed by Core qi that strikes all nearby.

name: Gyre Banner
description: Gathers the whole gale into the iron through a great orbit and lets it fall.

name: Vaunted Vigor Dropweight
description: The school's closing fall brings the gale and all its orbits down in one stroke of the weight.
